t: When you cannot see the end of it
a: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
p: Fa-inna maʿa-l-ʿusri yusrā. Inna maʿa-l-ʿusri yusrā.
m: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief]. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
